ending_commit_note: The final commit is supplied in the handoff because embedding its own hash would be self-referential; no post-commit mutation is permitted.
fixture_counting_method: A refusal fixture is one row that must be refused: every assertRaises block that fired, every exhaustive table row whose expected answer is refusal, and every parity mutation that must produce a non-passing report. A positive fixture is one row that must be admitted. Rows are counted once per category, so a reused record can appear in more than one category.

independent_oracle.method: The oracle declares the receipt and terminal contracts literally, including per-effect-classification process-exit and reconciliation policy. One test compares the implementation matrix with the oracle; every exhaustive test derives its expected answer from the oracle rows only.

known_limitations: No physical transport, direct runner, governed runner, shared effect executor, durable ledger, evaluator execution, or installed path exists in M1; every status above is bounded by that absence.
The authoritative reconciliation paths are pure precondition checkers. They cannot detect a later runtime that ignores the types, forges observations, or bypasses the effect substrate.
list_files scope, read_file line bounds, and run_command truncation semantics are defined here for the first time; a future executor must implement exactly these semantics or issue a new ADR.
Run ID minting, durable publication, and restart behaviour remain future obligations.
The repository M0 manifests and all historical or production evidence were not rewritten.

schema_version_decision.future_runtime_rule: A runtime must adopt these exact version-1 definitions before persistence or issue a new ADR and consistently increment the affected versions.
schema_version_decision.no_mixed_definition_can_deserialize: Exact-key deserialization refuses a pre-repair ExperimentSpecification (no tool_grammar or evaluator_specification), a pre-repair EffectReceipt (no tool binding, result channel, or effect application), and a pre-repair RunCommandResult (no process_started). A pre-repair WriteFileResult is refused by the fixed written-content fingerprint domain, and a pre-repair tool request is refused because its grammar fingerprint domain is not the grammar-specification domain.
schema_version_decision.reason: M1 still has no runtime or external persistence contract, every affected artifact is regenerated together, and the architecture document records that no pre-repair M1 object is accepted as authoritative.
